supersede_reason: Three material findings invalidate v1. (1) 24/7 delivery means calls arrive outside 08:00-16:00 and reach voicemail, so a duration threshold alone can no longer define a qualified call - v1 proposed raising 6885576934 to 60s as the qualifying rule. (2) WhatConverts is proven live and performing dynamic number insertion, and its two upload conversion actions have recorded ZERO conversions all-time. (3) Google's own website-call swap is inert on the paid pages.

measurement_findings_2026_08_18.whatconverts_is_live: PROVEN. Blocking s.ksrndkehqnwntyxlhgto.com and process.iconnode.com reverts the mobile Call Now button from (410) 914-1456 back to the server-HTML number. WhatConverts profile script 105803.js.
measurement_findings_2026_08_18.whatconverts_uploads_nothing: OBSERVED. Conversion actions 7643656075 'WC Calls' and 7643656486 'WC Lead' are both PRIMARY but have recorded 0.0 conversions in every window including all-time. They are configured and inert.
measurement_findings_2026_08_18.google_website_call_swap_is_inert_on_pai: OBSERVED. www.googleadservices.com/pagead/conversion/11155434808/wcm is called with dn=4104159517, a number that does not appear anywhere on the paid pages, and www.google.com/pagead/attribution/wcm returns {"errorCode":2,"backoff":3600}. Google therefore issues no forwarding number and performs no swap on offer. pages. The 19 conversions on 6885576934 in the last 365 days are attributable to the MAIN site, not to the paid landing pages.
measurement_findings_2026_08_18.ga4_phone_event_is_a_tap_not_a_call: INFERRED from volume. GA4 action 7389995488 recorded 352 phone events in 365 days against 57 real ad calls on 1068114183. A 6x ratio is consistent with a tel: tap event, not a connected call. It is already Secondary and excluded from Conversions.
measurement_findings_2026_08_18.attribution_never_reaches_the_form: OBSERVED. All seven Gravity Forms hidden fields stay empty on a click carrying gclid, gbraid, wbraid and five UTMs. No click ID can be returned in an offline upload.

principle: One deduplicated confirmed form submission is the Primary form action. A qualified call must be qualified by a HUMAN or CRM outcome, not by call duration, because 24/7 delivery routes out-of-hours calls to voicemail and a voicemail deposit easily exceeds any duration threshold.

voicemail_rule.problem: Google Ads counts an AD_CALL or WEBSITE_CALL conversion when the call connects for at least phone_call_duration_seconds. A voicemail pickup IS a connection. With ads eligible 168 hours a week and staff present roughly 40, a duration rule would count voicemail deposits as qualified calls.
voicemail_rule.rejected_approach: Raising 6885576934 from 30s to 60s as the qualifying rule (v1).
voicemail_rule.chosen_approach: Keep the duration-based call actions as LEAD INDICATORS, and make the authoritative qualified call an OFFLINE uploaded outcome after human or CRM review. Until that upload exists, no call action is treated as a qualified-lead source for bidding.
voicemail_rule.callback_and_later_qualification: A voicemail is a lead, not a qualified call. The business calls back, qualifies, and the CRM stamps the outcome. That outcome is uploaded against the ORIGINAL click identifier captured at the landing page, with the original click timestamp, so the conversion is credited to the click that produced it rather than to the callback. This requires the landing-page attribution fix first.
